description: This file implements the game state management for a Tic Tac Toe game within an Android application. It handles game logic such as moves, game status, saving and restoring game state, and providing status messages for the UI.

classes.name: TicTacToeState
classes.description: Class managing the game state and logic for Tic Tac Toe, including move processing, game status, and state persistence.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Processes a move when the user taps a cell; updates game state and returns the result.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game to the initial empty state.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Provides a localized string representing the current game status.

methods.name: saveToBundle
methods.description: Saves the current game state into a Bundle for activity recreation.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores the game state from a Bundle after activity recreation.
